name.value: Cocoa FL example site (555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926; an industrial-park parcel in Brevard County)
name.basis: the example Earth-surface site design demonstrating the parcel path (AQS-SITE-014)
name.owner: owner basis: the parcel address supplied by the project owner (555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926)

latitude_deg.verification_test: parcel survey at 555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926
latitude_deg.owner: owner basis: the parcel address supplied by the project owner (555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926)

longitude_deg.verification_test: parcel survey at 555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926
longitude_deg.owner: owner basis: the parcel address supplied by the project owner (555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926)

elevation_m.verification_test: parcel survey; the site is low-relief riverine terrain near the Indian River lagoon
elevation_m.owner: owner basis: the parcel address supplied by the project owner (555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926)

site_basis.value: AQS-SITE-014 (parcel interface; the example site design)

parcel_policy.value: named parcel: 555 South Industry Rd, Cocoa FL 32926 (Brevard County industrial park). The parcel-selection application (AQS-SITE-014) supplies the boundary, the ASCE Hazard Tool run, the geotechnical report and the Wenner test; the values below are the published central-Brevard classes pending that export.
parcel_policy.owner: Q-033 closure: a parcel is named when a site design is commissioned - this profile IS that named site

crew.basis: Q-029: the issued HAB design occupancy; the crew is a profile entry derived from the locale habitable volume and food production

g_m_s2.note: standard gravity; local gravity at the study site differs by about 0.1 %

pressure_Pa.verification_test: Site barometric pressure for the station elevation (ASHRAE climatic design conditions, AQS-SITE-002 [B1]); the study uses the standard atmosphere

composition_mole_fraction.units: mole fraction, dry air, rounded to four places

vent_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002 (open site; vents and stacks discharge to outside air)

oxidant.note: air carries O2 at the composition above

cooling_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: ASHRAE climatic design conditions, Melbourne Intl AP (WMO 747945); PVWatts/TMY3 bin-hour calculation
cooling_dry_bulb_C.note: C (0.4 % design dry bulb, about 93 F)

heating_dry_bulb_C.units: C (99.6 % design dry bulb, about 35 F)
heating_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: ASHRAE climatic design conditions, Melbourne Intl AP (WMO 747945)

site_design_dry_bulb_C.basis: location-neutral bounding (AQS-SITE-002 Rev C): the strictest value across the daily-cycle localization set, carried from the governing site profile. A site design replaces it with its own published value. Governing site: death_valley (0.4 % cooling, NOAA_NORMALS_DV).
site_design_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: the site design tool run for the chosen location replaces the bounding value

pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.verification_test: NREL PVWatts v8 site run at the parcel (Cocoa FL); TMY3 hourly

night_hours.verification_test: TMY3 longest-night statistics for the site

basic_wind_speed_m_s.verification_test: ASCE Hazard Tool at the parcel; the site design may adopt the special wind region study if the county publishes one
basic_wind_speed_m_s.note: m/s basic wind speed (about 140 mph, ASCE 7-22 Risk II coastal contour)

roof_snow_kPa.note: Brevard County: ground snow load zero per the ASCE 7-22 maps

SDS_g.units: g design short-period spectral acceleration = 2/3 Fa Ss
SDS_g.verification_test: ASCE Hazard Tool at the parcel (Florida is the CONUS low-seismic minimum)

SD1_g.units: g design 1 s spectral acceleration = 2/3 Fv S1
SD1_g.verification_test: ASCE Hazard Tool at the parcel

allowable_bearing_kPa.verification_test: Geotechnical investigation per IBC 1803 at the parcel (Brevard coastal sand; the standard presumes it until borings land)

unit_weight_kN_m3.verification_test: the geotechnical report at the parcel

resistivity_ohm_m.verification_test: Wenner four-pin soil-resistivity test at the parcel (X-ELS-08)
resistivity_ohm_m.note: ohm m moist coastal sand class

ghex_capacity_W_m.verification_test: the GHEX sizing at the parcel soils

groundwater_depth_m.units: m below grade (seasonal high, coastal riverine terrain)
groundwater_depth_m.verification_test: the geotechnical report and the seasonal-high water table at the parcel; governs the mat uplift check (AQS-BLD-017)
groundwater_depth_m.owner: owner basis: the coastal riverine terrain class at the parcel; the geotechnical report at the parcel replaces it

radiation.not_applicable: Earth surface under the atmosphere: natural background only, no shielding design case

ac_frequency_Hz.units: Hz line frequency (IEC 60034-30-1 60 Hz IE3 basis, AQS-INV-005)

value.register: owner ruling D-GEO_ORC (installed standby at 0 kW electric)

worst_stretch.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 5.5 (the baseline worst stretch is the night)

oversize_factor.units: PV nameplate / PV needed to close the daily balance
oversize_factor.verification_test: NREL NSRDB TMY hourly run (PVWatts v8) for the site: fraction of days with yield below 1/factor of the mean; export tariff from the serving utility
oversize_factor.published: Owner decision, Mike Matthews 2026-10-15 (D75): 200 % of plant requirement; storage still charges on a day at half the mean yield, surplus exported

actions.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 6.2 (no manual factor: the profile physical values drive the scaling)

buoyant_separation.register: AQS-SITE-002; gravity.g_m_s2 above zero, steady in direction (fixed foundation)

air_heat_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002; open site; cooling design dry bulb AQS-SITE-002

ground_contact.register: AQS-SITE-002; land site, soil per AQS-SITE-002

liquid_water_at_ambient.register: AQS-SITE-002; atmosphere.pressure_Pa above the triple point of water
